question: Does removing pair features improve novel-target ranking while harming aggregate ranking?
rationale: Operational questions chosen after inspecting previous development pilots; one bounded reproduction/extension batch, not new independent confirmation. The tolerance is chosen for this study, not a domain constant.

estimand.interval: 95% paired user-cluster bootstrap; conditional descriptive development uncertainty
estimand.evidence_boundary: Pilot-informed and development-only; already seen pilot and historical overnight outputs. No preregistration, blind confirmation, independent sample or final-test claim.

decision_rule.supported: novel ci_low > 0 AND all ci_high < 0, evaluated separately within each protocol
decision_rule.unsupported: novel ci_high < 0 OR all ci_low > 0 (a required sign contradicted at the stated precision)
decision_rule.inconclusive: otherwise, including uncertain signs; preserve equal-user and repeat-target diagnostics
decision_rule.qualification: This is the nine-feature original-model ablation, not a manual-model ablation.
